done_when: A committed, tested DEV-only content manifest and a synthetic-tested paired inference specification exist; no outcome columns or VALIDATION/HOLDOUT data were read.
goal: Make future WaveTrend DEV results reproducible by content-pinning the exact input bars and freezing a matched day/block inference method before any new outcomes are read.
note: Never modify frozen atlas outputs or ledger rows. Create any new exposure entry only alongside the new preregistration.
scope_out: Do not read or calculate any returns/outcomes; do not read VALIDATION/HOLDOUT; do not modify frozen atlas outputs or ledger rows.
steps: Create a frozen manifest for the exact 30 pre-cutoff 1m DEV source files with names, sizes, SHA-256, timestamp coverage, duplicate and missing-minute counts, and usable bars by timeframe.
Add a fail-first test for duplicate/gap detection and ensure the manifest generator refuses any input at or after the 2024-07-01 cutoff.

Specify and test a matched day/block resampling or randomization method that preserves common-clock/event clustering for the event and control arms; record the method in a new analysis-version design without running outcomes.
Create a new exposure-ledger entry only when a preregistration is ready; never rewrite historical rows.
tests: Add fail-first test_input_manifest.py covering cutoff refusal, duplicate timestamps, missing-minute count and file digest; add test_paired_inference.py with synthetic paired day blocks whose expected contrast is hand-computed.
title: WaveTrend DEV input manifest and matched inference
